---
title: "Posts"
listing:
  id: posts-listing
  contents: "posts/*.qmd"
  template: posts.ejs
  sort: "title"
  categories: cloud
mathviz-page:
  category-cloud: true
---

<!-- A custom-template listing, the page's only one, the way a blog index
     lists its posts as plain rows: category-cloud.js must move the cloud
     above it, with "All" first, since there is no grid, default or table
     listing for it to prefer. The cloud is turned on by mathviz-page:
     alone -- this site sets no project mathviz: -- so the page also checks
     that a page option works without project ones. -->

<style>
.vm-category-cloud .quarto-listing-category { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.vm-category-cloud .category { cursor: pointer; color: var(--vm-text-soft); }
.vm-category-cloud .category.active { color: var(--vm-accent); font-weight: 500; }
</style>
